name: The Gun You Found This Morning

description.value:
Duration constant

Familiarity is for people who get to keep things.

You suffer no penalty for using an unfamiliar, improvised, or non-proficient firearm, treating any such weapon as though you had your highest weapon proficiency with it. A weapon you have carried for more than a day loses this benefit until you have set it down for a full day — this is not skill with a gun, it is skill with strangers.

cinderfall.incomplete: the proficiency-normalization half is plausible in isolation, but the "loses this if carried more than a day" clause is a stateful tracked condition with no roll-option hook to flag elapsed carry-time, and I found no companion effect to carry that state — net INCOMPLETE.
